name: mndy-mcp
description: Marketing and ecommerce analytics for Claude, plus the mndy MCP servers. Ships an 'analytics' skill covering which server answers which question, working across GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads and Shopify at once, per-brand account targeting, and reporting numbers honestly (null KPIs are not zero; money is in the account's own currency). Bundles a .mcp.json registering the servers over HTTP for Claude Code, a skill per server documenting its tools, and operational skills: 'brands' for switching brand per session without restarting, and 'meta-token' for refreshing the Meta access token. Claude Desktop users should run `make install-desktop` in the mndy repo instead, which wires the servers over stdio.
